publishedRecipe.name: Spicy Asian Pork, Bok Choy & Snap Pea Stir-Fry over Jasmine Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 baby bok choy
2 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
2 small bunches green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice cooks, place broth, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp soy sauce
4 tsp rice vinegar
2 tsp brown sugar
2 tsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into 1-inch strips; place in a large bowl.
Halve snap peas crosswise and add to the bowl with the bok choy; set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ lb lean ground pork

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the veggies.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
When the pork is done, add veggies, ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet; stir-fry until veggies soften, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add sauce to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates; sprinkle with reserved green onion and enjoy!

altVariants.name: Spicy Asian Veggie Ground, Bok Choy & Snap Pea Stir-Fry over Rice
altVariants.blurb: Indulge in the bold and fiery flavors of our Spicy Asian Pork Stir-Fry! Tender pork, crispy snap peas, and bok choy are tossed in a heat-packed stir fry sauce, then served over a bed of fluffy jasmine rice
